verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only cloud-based development surfaces (Snowsight Notebooks, Snowflake CLI, dbt Projects on Snowflake) that require an active, billed Snowflake account/warehouse — there is no local engine, emulator, or sandbox to develop transformations before touching production compute. Community evidence even confirms that a trial account consumes real credits/costs from the start, underscoring the lack of a free/local dev loop.
